# Projecting Wealth

``` r

library(wealthR)
```

## Description

Computes the future value of an investment using a combined formula for
a single lump-sum principal and a series of monthly contributions
(Ordinary Annuity). It handles edge cases where the interest rate is
zero to prevent calculation errors.

## Usage

calc_wealth(principal, monthly, rate, years)

## Arguments

- `principal`: Numeric. Initial lump-sum investment.
- `monthly`: Numeric. Monthly contribution amount made at the end of
  each month.
- `rate`: Numeric. Annual nominal rate of return (as a decimal, e.g.,
  0.05 for 5%). Must be non-negative.
- `years`: Numeric. Total duration of the investment.

## Value

A numeric vector representing the account balance at each monthly
interval throughout the specified duration.

## Example

``` r

# Project wealth with $10,000 start, $500 monthly additions at 6% return for 30 years
wealth_trajectory <- calc_wealth(principal = 10000, monthly = 500, rate = 0.06, years = 30)
```
